old_rules.precision: v2.0.2 item 1: d_i = max decimal places among symbol's stored adjusted closes; delta_i = 0.5*10^-d_i for every session
old_rules.identity_unverified: v2.0.2 rule 4a: BLOCKING until same-provider anchor or committed reviewer decision; evidence and decisions unspecified

rationale.precision: v2.0.2 assumed one precision per symbol; DAY-18B representation histograms refute this for 5 symbols. A per-value bound is a guaranteed rounding-error bound (displayed decimals <= stored precision); the 2-decimal floor only tightens it (fail-safe). Selected by representation logic, not by outcomes; not applied in this task.
rationale.review_records: frozen §3.4 and v2.0.2 rule 4a require reviews but defined neither recorder, evidence nor provenance; a committed, immutable, human-decided record makes every resolution auditable and reproducible.
rationale.amzn_nvda: unexplained or unconfirmed cross-check items must stay BLOCKING unless mechanics or documented same-provider evidence resolve them; magnitude and economic neutrality are never evidence.
rationale.identity: the provider offers no CUSIP anchor for CRM/AMD (asset cusip null); primary regulatory filings are admitted for the identity decision only, so the decision can rest on documentary evidence rather than economic neutrality.

precision_rule.name: per-value precision with 2-decimal floor
precision_rule.d_k: decimal places of the shortest round-trip decimal representation of stored adjusted close a_k (trailing zeros not counted)
precision_rule.rho: f_k / f_p, f = r / a, consecutive common sessions p<k
precision_rule.precision_degenerate: a_p - delta_p <= 0 or a_k - delta_k <= 0 -> BLOCKING

arguments: displayed decimals d_k <= stored precision P, so rounding error <= 0.5*10^-P <= 0.5*10^-d_k: a guaranteed upper bound under round-to-nearest
2-decimal floor: 0- and 1-decimal shares in the 10 measured symbols (~0.2-1.7% and ~3.6-11%) match trailing-zero frequencies of storage at >= 2 decimals (~1% and ~9%)
the floor only tightens the bound -> a false assumption yields false BLOCKING, never a false pass
identical to v2.0.2 for series with <= 2 decimals; differs only for mixed-precision series

rejected_candidates.per_value_without_floor: valid but loose (delta 0.05/0.5 on ~10% of sessions could hide a missing event)
rejected_candidates.dominant_or_mode_precision: not an error bound; NVDA shows two precision regimes

precision_rule_selection_basis.non_iteration: rule frozen without evaluation on any Stage R symbol; if it blocks later it is not adjusted and re-run; a further change needs a new amendment justified by representation evidence

mixed_precision_handling.handling: each value carries its own delta_k (floored at 2 decimals); the pairwise interval uses delta_p and delta_k separately
mixed_precision_handling.outcome_for_these_symbols: UNKNOWN until re-evaluation (not evaluated in DAY-18C)

review_record_mechanism.provenance: re-evaluation applies only records committed at its HEAD; validates schema, item_key and snapshot manifest hash; stores each record blob SHA-256
